column1: # case-params.tsv — Per-case SCF parameter overrides for the 30 non-converged 54-atom cases
# Reference: NFM-3381 analysis-plan.md Section 2 (proposed parameter changes by category)
#   case_id           — structure directory name (e.g. comp_0019_III from NFM-3378 evidence)
#   category          — A=oscillation, B=stagnation, C=divergence, D=time-limit, E=kpoint-crash
#   MAGMOM            — starting magnetization: "FM", "AFM", or per-atom list
#   ALGO              — VASP algorithm: Normal | Fast | All | VeryFast
#   POTIM             — ionic step size (default 0, VASP picks)
#   wall_seconds      — wall-clock consumed by original (failed) attempt
#   scf_steps_attempted — SCF steps before original failure
# Populated from inspection of `convergence NOT achieved` .out files on xingyi.
# Left blank intentionally — NDE fills via categorize_cases.py when xingyi access is available.
